newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads man for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads man for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Thursday beheaded a Saudi man convicted of shooting another Saudi dead, Saudi state television reported.
It was the second execution in two days. On Wednesday a Saudi man was beheaded for murdering his uncle.
The latest execution in the town of Hafouf in the kingdom's Eastern Province brought to 44 the number of people beheaded by the sword in Saudi Arabia this year.
Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
